title: Thank you, New Orleans
summary: Thank you for making energy efficiency part of your year. Explore helpful resources for a more comfortable home this season.
body_markdown:
**Thank you for being part of Energy Smart this year**


To everyone who took part in Energy Smart this year, thank you. Whether you made a home upgrade or tried a new energy-saving habit, we appreciate the steps you took to reduce energy waste at home.


New to Energy Smart? We help eligible Entergy New Orleans residential customers find energy-saving tips, guidance and program options. Whether you own or rent, our resources can help you decide where to start.


As the holidays approach, explore simple ways to manage your home’s energy use and stay comfortable. If you’re thinking about home improvements in 2027, you can also learn about program options as you begin planning.


Whether you’re looking for a practical gift or a simple way to enhance comfort at home, these products can help you save energy while making everyday life a little easier.


Thank you again for being part of Energy Smart. We’re grateful for the opportunity to help you make your home more comfortable and energy efficient.


**[Explore more ways to save](https://energysmartnola.info/residents)**


**Holiday offers for your home**


Explore featured products in the Energy Smart Online Marketplace from November 11 through December 1, 2026:


- Google Nest and ecobee smart thermostats starting at $0 to help manage heating and cooling.
- Advanced power strips for $9.79 to help reduce standby energy use from electronics.
- Air purifiers for $48.99 to help improve indoor air quality.


Visit the Online Marketplace for eligible products and offer details. Check compatibility before choosing.
